indication: metastatic or unresectable leiomyosarcoma (uterine and soft-tissue), first line
biomarker: none required (histology-selected)
design: randomized open-label phase 3 (LMS-04): doxorubicin + trabectedin x6 then trabectedin maintenance, vs doxorubicin alone
intervention: doxorubicin + trabectedin, then trabectedin maintenance (LMS-04 regimen)
inclusion_match_notes: This is the regimen her consulting oncologist has planned, and she matches the trial population: systemic-therapy-naive metastatic LMS with ECOG 0-1 required. Her ECOG of 1 is an intake assumption never documented, baseline LVEF is not on file (the trial required cardiac eligibility before doxorubicin), and her altitude-shifted haemoglobin baseline will complicate dose-modification calls. The infiltrative pulmonary pattern may make RECIST target-lesion selection harder than usual; a pre-treatment baseline scan is still open as a to-do.
intervention_dosing: doxorubicin 60 mg/m2 + trabectedin 1.1 mg/m2 q3w x6 cycles, then trabectedin maintenance to progression or unacceptable toxicity

indication: previously untreated advanced or metastatic soft-tissue sarcoma (LMS-predominant, incl. uterine)
biomarker: none required (histology-selected)
design: randomized open-label phase 3 (GeDDiS, ISRCTN07742377): gemcitabine + docetaxel vs doxorubicin
inclusion_match_notes: Not a trial she can enter (completed); kept because gemcitabine + docetaxel is the first-line fallback if her undocumented baseline LVEF or pulmonary reserve at 8,500 ft rules out full-dose doxorubicin. GeDDiS found no advantage over doxorubicin, which supports the planned anthracycline-based LMS-04 induction rather than displacing it.
intervention_dosing: gemcitabine 675 mg/m2 d1,8 + docetaxel 75 mg/m2 d8 q3w

indication: metastatic non-adipocytic soft-tissue sarcoma after prior chemotherapy (incl. anthracycline)
biomarker: none required
design: randomized double-blind placebo-controlled phase 3 (PALETTE)
inclusion_match_notes: PALETTE required prior anthracycline, so she is ineligible for pazopanib's evidence population today and becomes label-eligible only after LMS-04. Recorded as the approved later-line backbone the investigational options below have to beat; it also sits on the comparator arm of the olaparib/temozolomide randomized trial.

indication: advanced liposarcoma or leiomyosarcoma after ≥2 prior regimens incl. anthracycline
biomarker: none required
design: randomized open-label phase 3: eribulin vs dacarbazine
inclusion_match_notes: Requires two prior regimens including an anthracycline, so this door opens two lines from now at the earliest. The OS benefit concentrated in liposarcoma and the FDA label is liposarcoma-only; in her LMS the drug would be off-label with a neutral subgroup result, which the board should weigh against trial options at that point.

indication: metastatic leiomyosarcoma, first line (SaLuDo)
biomarker: none required; anthracycline-naive with ECOG ≤1 and LVEF >50% required
design: randomized phase 3: lurbinectedin + doxorubicin vs doxorubicin alone
inclusion_match_notes: She matches this trial's eligibility profile almost exactly — anthracycline-naive metastatic LMS, ECOG ≤1, documented LVEF — but accrual closed before her diagnosis was corrected, so the row is informational. It is the clearest illustration of how narrow the first-line trial window is in LMS, and its readout will bear directly on how the LMS-04 backbone evolves. Her ECOG and LVEF, both required here, remain undocumented.

indication: unresectable or metastatic leiomyosarcoma, 1-3 prior lines (or declined first-line standard of care)
biomarker: none required
design: single-arm phase 2 of ivonescimab (PD-1 x VEGF bispecific antibody)
inclusion_match_notes: Enrolls LMS after 1-3 prior lines, with an unusual clause admitting patients who decline first-line standard of care — so it is technically open to her now, though her planned LMS-04 induction is the better first move and keeps her eligible here afterward. ECOG ceiling is 0-2; hers is an undocumented intake assumption. Measurable disease and archival tissue are required, and the infiltrative pulmonary pattern may complicate target-lesion selection.

indication: advanced or metastatic leiomyosarcoma after standard-of-care chemotherapy
biomarker: none required
design: single-arm phase 2 of all-trans retinoic acid + cemiplimab
inclusion_match_notes: Requires prior standard-of-care chemotherapy, so it opens once LMS-04 fails; no cap on prior lines. ECOG 0-2 allowed, but her score is an intake assumption that needs documenting, and RECIST-measurable disease is required against an infiltrative pulmonary pattern. No biomarker gate — one of the few immunotherapy routes in LMS that does not wait on her missing profiling.

indication: advanced leiomyosarcoma or dedifferentiated liposarcoma (phase 2 may be systemic-treatment naive)
biomarker: intact Rb protein by IHC required (phase 2); prior gemcitabine not allowed
design: phase 1/2 of abemaciclib (CDK4/6 inhibitor) + gemcitabine
inclusion_match_notes: The phase 2 LMS cohort accepts systemic-treatment-naive patients, and prior doxorubicin/trabectedin would not exclude her later since only prior gemcitabine is barred — so this stays open before and after LMS-04. Entry is gated on Rb-intact IHC, a single stain she has not had; the same stain read the other way gates the REC-617 trial, so one assay settles which of the two doors exists. ECOG ceiling 0-2, undocumented in her case.

indication: metastatic or unresectable RB1-negative leiomyosarcoma after ≥1 prior systemic line
biomarker: RB1-negative by IHC (0% expression) required
design: open-label phase 1b of REC-617, a selective CDK7 inhibitor
inclusion_match_notes: RB1 loss is common in uLMS but hers has never been tested; RB1 IHC on the archival block is the assay that decides whether this trial exists for her, in mirror image to the Rb-intact requirement of the abemaciclib study. Requires ≥1 prior line, so it slots in after LMS-04, plus a biopsy-amenable lesion and measurable disease. ECOG ceiling is 2; her score is an undocumented intake assumption.

indication: metastatic or unresectable leiomyosarcoma after ≥2 prior lines (cohort 1)
biomarker: none required
design: phase 2 of zanzalintinib (multi-targeted TKI) with LMS-specific cohort
inclusion_match_notes: The LMS cohort requires at least two prior lines, so this is a third-line-or-later option that becomes reachable only after LMS-04 and one further regimen. Pathology review at an NCCN center is required, which her pending expert re-review would satisfy. Kept as the successor-generation TKI alternative to label-approved pazopanib.

indication: advanced alveolar soft part sarcoma, leiomyosarcoma, synovial sarcoma (APROMISS); LMS indications closed
biomarker: none required
design: phase 3 of anlotinib (catequentinib) vs dacarbazine; LMS arms suspended, 'any sarcoma' indication E open
inclusion_match_notes: The registry status is recruiting, but both LMS-specific indications are marked closed/suspended to new accrual; only the loosely defined 'any sarcomas or other solid tumors' indication E remains open, which weakens the fit considerably. Prior-line requirements applied to the LMS arms (≥1 approved therapy), so she would not have qualified before LMS-04 anyway. Kept so the anlotinib/TKI axis is visible with its true enrollment state.

indication: newly diagnosed FIGO stage I uterine leiomyosarcoma, ER-positive (>10% IHC), adjuvant setting
biomarker: ER expression >10% by IHC required
design: randomized phase 2 of adjuvant letrozole vs observation (GOG Foundation)
inclusion_match_notes: Excluded twice over: her tumor is ER <1% against a >10% requirement, and the trial takes stage I disease with no measurable lesions where she has bilateral pulmonary metastases. Recorded deliberately as the concrete face of the endocrine foreclosure her confirmed ER/PR negative creates — the one biomarker answer this case already has. If the pending specimen-provenance check overturned the receptor result, this class would need re-screening, though the stage criterion would still exclude her here.

indication: advanced uterine leiomyosarcoma after ≥1 prior systemic line (NCI protocol 10250)
biomarker: no HRD entry gate; 31% of enrolled carried HRR mutations, RAD51-foci HRD tracked benefit (mPFS 11.2 vs 5.4 months)
design: single-arm phase 2 of olaparib + temozolomide
inclusion_match_notes: The strongest non-cytotoxic signal in uLMS, and she will match its population (≥1 prior line, ECOG ≤2) the day LMS-04 stops working; accrual to this protocol itself is closed, so access runs through the randomized successor or off-trial use. Entry was not HRD-gated, but benefit concentrated in HR-deficient tumors — her HRR/HRD status is unmeasured, which is exactly the panel the target-validation track has already queued. Her ECOG is an undocumented intake assumption.
intervention_dosing: olaparib 200 mg BID d1-7 + temozolomide 75 mg/m2 d1-7 q3w

indication: advanced uterine leiomyosarcoma after ≥2 prior lines including an anthracycline
biomarker: no HRD gate; prior PARP inhibitor, temozolomide or dacarbazine excluded
design: randomized phase 2/3: olaparib + temozolomide vs investigator's choice (trabectedin or pazopanib)
inclusion_match_notes: The confirmatory successor to NCI 10250 and the natural destination if LMS-04 and one further line fail: she would arrive anthracycline-exposed as required, and having received trabectedin but not pazopanib still permits the investigator's-choice arm. Currently closed to new accrual, so the practical move is to watch for reopening or readout rather than plan enrollment. Requires measurable disease, which the infiltrative pulmonary pattern may complicate.

indication: advanced solid tumors, TMB-high and MSI-H cohorts (KEYNOTE-158)
biomarker: TMB ≥10 mut/Mb (FoundationOne CDx) or MSI-H/dMMR — both unmeasured in this patient
design: multicohort single-arm phase 2 basket
inclusion_match_notes: Cannot be scored for her either way: TMB, MSI and MMR have simply never been tested, and uLMS is usually TMB-low and MMR-proficient, so the expected result is negative but the assays are cheap and already queued. A positive would make pembrolizumab label-available rather than trial-dependent — noting that the TMB-H indication requires progression on prior therapy, so it could not precede LMS-04 anyway. dMMR would also open dostarlimab under the same tumor-agnostic logic.

indication: TRK fusion-positive solid tumors, any histology (pooled NAVIGATE/SCOUT/phase 1)
biomarker: NTRK1/2/3 in-frame fusion — requires the RNA-based fusion assay she has not had
design: pooled analysis of three single-arm phase 1/2 trials
inclusion_match_notes: Gated on a test, not a result: no fusion assay of any kind has been run, and the spindle-cell morphology plus the earlier benign misdiagnosis are precisely the setting where an NTRK-rearranged mesenchymal tumor hides. A positive converts the plan to an oral TRK inhibitor under the tumor-agnostic approvals (larotrectinib, entrectinib, repotrectinib — the repotrectinib trial NCT03093116 is still recruiting). Prevalence in true uLMS is very low, so this is a cheap-to-close long shot, and the DNA-only panels that miss NTRK introns would not close it.

indication: HER2-expressing (IHC 3+/2+) advanced solid tumors after prior therapy (DESTINY-PanTumor02)
biomarker: HER2 IHC 3+ or 2+ — never stained in this patient; tumor-agnostic approval is IHC 3+ only
design: multicohort single-arm phase 2 basket
inclusion_match_notes: HER2 has never been stained here and meaningful expression in uLMS is uncommon, so this is a low-prior gate that the already-planned IHC bundle closes for the cost of one slide; only an IHC 3+ result would make T-DXd label-available (after prior systemic therapy), and sarcoma was not among the trial's named cohorts. The drug's ILD risk deserves an early note: her bilateral infiltrative lung disease and 8,500 ft baseline oximetry would make pneumonitis surveillance genuinely hard to read.

indication: advanced synovial sarcoma / myxoid round cell liposarcoma (SPEARHEAD-1)
biomarker: HLA-A*02 allele + MAGE-A4 expression ≥1+ in ≥10% of cells (central IHC); both unassessable in this patient (HLA untyped, antigen unstained)
design: single-arm phase 2 of afamitresgene autoleucel (MAGE-A4 TCR-T)
inclusion_match_notes: Included for informational value only: the trial and the resulting approval are restricted to synovial sarcoma and MRCLS, so she cannot enroll or receive it on label, and no MAGE-A4 program currently enrolls LMS. It anchors what the engineered-T-cell class can do in sarcoma once the two gates she has never been tested for — HLA-A*02 genotype and MAGE-A4 IHC — are known; the trial also required prior anthracycline/ifosfamide, LVEF ≥50% and ECOG 0-1, all axes undocumented or pending in her case. HLA typing is a blood draw and settles half of this class in one step.

indication: recurrent/refractory PRAME-positive solid tumors, HLA-A*02:01-restricted (ACTengine IMA203)
biomarker: HLA-A*02:01 genotype + PRAME expression by sponsor qPCR — both unmeasured; ECOG 0-1 required
design: phase 1/2 basket of IMA203 / IMA203CD8 PRAME TCR-T, monotherapy or with nivolumab
inclusion_match_notes: A genuine basket: entry runs on HLA-A*02:01 plus PRAME expression rather than histology, and sarcomas have been treated in earlier cohorts, so uLMS is not categorically excluded the way the MAGE-A4 programs exclude it. Both gates are unmeasured for her — HLA typing (blood draw) then reflex PRAME testing is the two-step the validation track already sequenced, though reported PRAME levels in LMS run below synovial sarcoma. Requires progression after available standard therapy, so timing follows LMS-04; ECOG 0-1 is required and hers is an undocumented assumption.

indication: metastatic/unresectable synovial sarcoma or myxoid round cell liposarcoma, HLA-A*02:01-positive
biomarker: HLA-A*02:01 genotype required; PRAME-directed (ImmTAC)
design: phase 2 of brenetafusp (PRAME x CD3 ImmTAC) in rare cancers (NCI)
inclusion_match_notes: This protocol names synovial sarcoma and MRCLS only, so it is informational for her — but it marks the PRAME/HLA-A*02:01 ImmTAC class arriving in sarcoma, an off-the-shelf alternative to TCR-T on the identical eligibility platform. Whether any of this class is assessable for her turns on the same untyped HLA allele and unstained PRAME as the IMA203 row. Watch for histology expansion; the drug is in phase 3 in melanoma.

indication: advanced solid tumors including sarcoma (named cohort)
biomarker: B7-H3-directed; no expression gate at entry (97% of soft-tissue sarcomas B7-H3-positive, PMID 39478506)
design: phase 1 dose escalation/expansion of MGC026 (B7-H3 ADC)
inclusion_match_notes: Sarcoma is on the named tumor-type list and US sites are recruiting, making this the most accessible B7-H3 ADC route for her once standard options are exhausted after LMS-04. Entry is not gated on B7-H3 IHC, but the planned local stain still earns its place by telling the board whether a referral is worth the trip — a strong positive is the single most likely surface-target finding in this histology. Archival tissue is required and available from the 2024 resection.

indication: advanced/metastatic solid tumors after progression on available standard therapy (EMBOLD)
biomarker: B7-H3-directed; no expression gate at entry
design: phase 1 dose escalation/expansion of GSK5764227 (HS-20093, B7-H3 ADC) alone and in combinations
inclusion_match_notes: All-comers dose escalation with US sites for the B7-H3 ADC that already has sarcoma-specific activity signals from its Chinese sister studies; monotherapy escalation requires progression on or intolerance of all standard options, which places it after LMS-04 and probably one further line. ECOG 0-1 is required with no recent deterioration — her score is an undocumented intake assumption, and this trial's ceiling is stricter than most of the sarcoma rows. Measurable disease per RECIST is required against her infiltrative pulmonary pattern.

indication: relapsed/refractory osteosarcoma and other sarcomas after first-line systemic treatment (ARTEMIS-002)
biomarker: B7-H3-directed; no expression gate; prior B7-H3 therapy excluded
design: phase 2 of HS-20093 (B7-H3 ADC) in sarcoma
inclusion_match_notes: The sarcoma-dedicated trial of the same ADC as the EMBOLD row, and 'other sarcomas' after first-line failure would read on her post-LMS-04 — but every site is in China, which makes it geographically impractical for a US-band patient and the fit weak. Kept because its sarcoma cohorts are what give the EMBOLD/GSK program its disease-specific rationale. ECOG 0-1 required, undocumented in her case.

indication: metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer and other solid tumors (TAMARACK program context)
biomarker: B7-H3-directed
design: phase 2 of vobramitamab duocarmazine (B7-H3 ADC, duocarmycin payload); terminated
inclusion_match_notes: Legacy context, not an option: MacroGenics halted this B7-H3 ADC program after safety findings in the prostate-cancer studies, and the row is here so the board reads the class with its failures in view — payload choice, not the target, is where B7-H3 ADCs have differed. The same sponsor's successor ADC (MGC026, different payload) is the recruiting row above. Different tumor type; she was never a candidate.

indication: relapsed/refractory soft-tissue sarcoma, FAP-positive by FAPi PET
biomarker: FAP expression demonstrated on [64Cu]LNTH-1363S FAPi PET — FAP never assessed in this patient; sarcomas are characteristically FAP-high
design: phase 1 dose escalation of [225Ac]RTX-2358 (FAP-targeted alpha radioligand) with FAPi PET selection gate
inclusion_match_notes: A therapeutic alpha-emitter, not an imaging study: the 64Cu-FAPi scan is the selection gate for the 225Ac payload, and one prior regimen suffices, so she could screen directly after LMS-04. Radioligand crossfire does not require uniform antigen expression, which matters in a histology where surface-target heterogeneity undermines ADC and cell-therapy cutoffs. ECOG must be 0-1 (hers is an undocumented assumption), prior radioligand therapy and whole-pelvic RT are exclusions, and US/Canada sites are open.
intervention_dosing: [225Ac]RTX-2358 IV q8w up to 6 doses, dose-escalation cohorts

indication: advanced solid tumors with FAP-2286 uptake (LuMIERE)
biomarker: tumor uptake on [68Ga]Ga-FAP-2286 PET required — FAP status unmeasured in this patient
design: phase 1/2 theranostic: [68Ga]Ga-FAP-2286 PET selection, then [177Lu]Lu-FAP-2286 therapy, monotherapy and chemo combinations
inclusion_match_notes: The beta-emitter counterpart to the 225Ac row, on the same logic: a theranostic pair whose imaging arm is a selection gate for a therapeutic dose, screened here as therapy per protocol intent. Sarcoma is not excluded and mesenchymal tumors carry FAP on the malignant cells themselves, but her eligibility is unknowable until a FAP PET is done, and the trial expects exhaustion of standard options first. US sites are open under Novartis sponsorship.

indication: advanced soft-tissue sarcoma with disease control after 4-8 cycles of first-line anthracycline-based treatment (MELODY)
biomarker: none required; randomization within 8 weeks of last anthracycline dose
design: randomized phase 2: pegylated liposomal doxorubicin maintenance vs active surveillance
inclusion_match_notes: This is the randomized version of the maintenance question her LMS-04 plan answers by design (trabectedin continuation), and she would hit its enrollment window — controlled disease within 8 weeks of the last anthracycline dose — mid-2027 if induction goes well. All sites are in Taiwan, so for a US-band patient it is informational: evidence context for the maintenance decision rather than a destination. The 8-week randomization window is the kind of deadline her team should know exists in this space.

indication: metastatic or advanced high-grade bone/soft-tissue sarcoma after ≥1 systemic regimen (PRIMA)
biomarker: no PARP-inhibitor pretreatment; SBRT-amenable lesions required
design: phase 2 of PARP inhibition + stereotactic body radiotherapy + PD-1 blockade
intervention: PARP inhibitor + SBRT + immune checkpoint blockade
inclusion_match_notes: The only registered trial marrying two of this case's axes — PARP sensitization and SBRT to metastatic sarcoma lesions — so it stays as proof the combined systemic-plus-local strategy her oncologist sketched is being formally tested. All sites are in China (age 10-70, ECOG 0-2), which makes it informational rather than actionable for her. Her pulmonary lesions' infiltrative pattern would need to be SBRT-amenable, a question the pre-treatment imaging work-up will answer.

indication: sarcoma or colorectal metastases to lung undergoing pulmonary metastasectomy
biomarker: none; pulmonary function sufficient for planned metastasectomy required
design: phase 1/2 of pulmonary suffusion (regional lung chemotherapy) at the time of metastasectomy, with SBRT/ablation hybrid approaches permitted
endpoint: feasibility/safety; control of minimal residual disease
inclusion_match_notes: Kept for the consolidation branch her oncologist explicitly left open: if LMS-04 controls the disease, lung-directed local therapy becomes the question, and this Roswell Park study is a live US protocol at that exact decision point. Two case-specific caveats dominate: bilateral infiltrative (possibly inflammatory) disease may never become metastasectomy-appropriate anatomy, and surgical fitness will be judged on pulmonary reserve that must be measured against her 8,500 ft baseline, with PFTs still undone. ECOG ≤2 required, undocumented in her case.
